title: Habakkuk Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Habakkuk 1: the prophet's cry of "Violence!", the Chaldeans Yahweh raises up, and the fisherman's net.

questions.text: Who saw the revelation in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:1 says this is the revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

questions.text: What word does the prophet cry out to Yahweh in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:2 says he cries out to Yahweh "Violence!" and asks whether he will not save.

questions.text: What does verse 4 say has happened to the law?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:4 says the law is paralyzed, justice never prevails, and justice comes out perverted.

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh say he raises up?
questions.explanation: In Habakkuk 1:6 Yahweh says he raises up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation.

questions.text: Their horses are said to be swifter than what?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:8 says their horses are swifter than leopards and more fierce than the evening wolves.

questions.text: What does he gather like sand?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:9 says they all come for violence and he gathers prisoners like sand.

questions.text: At what does he laugh, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:10 says he laughs at every stronghold, because he builds up an earthen ramp and takes it.

questions.text: What is said of the one whose strength is his god?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:11 says he sweeps by like the wind and goes on, and that he is indeed guilty, whose strength is his god.

questions.text: Men are made like what, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:14 asks why he makes men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things that have no ruler over them.

questions.text: To what does he sacrifice in verse 16?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 1:16 says he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his food is good.
